prompt: When can a customer order another stamp at a lower price?
promptZh: 在什麼情況下，客戶能以較低價格加購鋼印？

options.text: When a revised drawing requires fewer details.
options.zh: 修改後的圖面細節變少時。
options.whyZh: 圖面修改後要重新詢價，沒有保證價格較低。

options.text: When the stamp is reordered within six months.
options.zh: 在六個月內再次訂購時。
options.whyZh: 六個月是材料邊料的留存時間，並非加購優惠期限。

options.text: When the stamp is made to the same drawing.
options.zh: 依照同一份圖面製作時。
options.whyZh: 加購價取決於是否使用原圖，與是否晚一點訂購無關。

options.text: When the customer pays for three impressions.
options.zh: 客戶支付三次試印費時。
options.whyZh: 三次是邊料須容納的試印次數，不是加購價的條件。

explanationZh: 加購價取決於是否使用原圖，與是否晚一點訂購無關。
evidence: Extras from that drawing cost less, even later; give us the original drawing number when reordering. / A changed drawing needs a new quote.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Extras from that drawing cost less, even later; give us the original drawing number when reordering.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A changed drawing needs a new quote.
